item.title: Marchment's Hot Start Gives Blue Jackets Some Intriguing Options
item.description: The Columbus Blue Jackets' trade for Mason Marchment is turning out to be a stroke of genius. With three goals in his first two games with the Jackets, he's closing back in on a 20-goal pace after a very slow start to the season with the Seattle Kraken. But in addition to the offensive boost he's given Columbus, Marchment has given the team some intriguing options moving forward this season, as cited by insider Frank Seravalli on his Bleacher Report Insider Notebook. item.title: David Tomasek and Edmonton Oilers Part Ways; Player Headed to New Team
item.description: His role with the team has been greatly diminished over the past couple of months, and now David Tomasek is officially finished with the Edmonton Oilers. The team will be placing him on waivers on Sunday (at the end of the NHL's Holiday Roster Freeze period) for the purpose of contract termination. item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs didn't take long to replace Marc Savard on their bench, as the team announced they've promoted Steve Sullivan to assistant coach.Sullivan joins the Leafs bench from the AHL's Toronto Marlies. He'll replace Savard, who was running the power play, which was ranked last in the entire NHL at just over 13% efficiency.
